approach: Write only a validated opened original credentials inode; retain complete private pending through fsync/readback/final path-and-inode/content check.
operatingCondition: Native app stopped and root readiness verified before fixture mutation.
removedApproach: Unconditional pathname rename after a pre-check.
failureContract: Partial write, fsync, readback or identity mismatch retains complete pending and reports review required; no retry, rollback, old-password backup or false success.
visibilityTradeoff: Rewrite is not atomic; durable pending supports explicit recovery.
publicationLimit: Final verification is the publication point; later external mutation cannot be ruled out.
